prompt: Write me a python script that exports all of my Outlook emails to a CSV and prepares them so that they are ready to use to finetune a LLM
response:
To export Outlook emails to a CSV and prepare them for fine-tuning a language model, you can use the following Python script. This script uses the `win32com.client` library to interact with Outlook and the `pandas` library to handle CSV export. Make sure to install the required libraries before running the script.

```python
import win32com.client
import pandas as pd
import csv

# Connect to Outlook
outlook = win32com.client.Dispatch("Outlook.Application").GetNamespace("MAPI")

# Get the Inbox folder
inbox = outlook.GetDefaultFolder(6)

# Get all emails in the Inbox
messages = inbox.Items

# Prepare a list to store email data
email_data = []

# Loop through each email
for message in messages:
    # Extract email subject and body
    subject = message.Subject
    body = message.Body
    
    # Combine subject and body into a single text
    text = f"{subject} {body}"
    
    # Append email data to the list
    email_data.append({"text": text})

# Convert the list to a DataFrame
df = pd.DataFrame(email_data)

# Export the DataFrame to a CSV file
df.to_csv("outlook_emails.csv", index=False)

print("Emails exported to CSV successfully.")
```

This script will export all emails in your Outlook Inbox to a CSV file named `outlook_emails.csv`. The CSV will contain a single column named `text`, which includes the combined subject and body of each email. This format is suitable for fine-tuning a language model.
